topics.label: Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session by connecting it to prior practicals and outlining the day's learning outcomes.

topics.label: Viral Oncology and Cellular Transformation Assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace the discovery of viral oncogenesis and detail the experimental methods used to assess oncogenic transformation in cells.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Classification of Oncogenes and Tumor Suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the functional classifications of cancer genes and illustrate their dominant and recessive effects through cell cycle regulators and p53.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Consequences of Genetic Instability in Cancer Progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how failures in DNA repair, replication, and mitotic segregation drive sequence and chromosomal instability throughout multistep tumorigenesis.

topics.label: Hereditary Cancer Predispositions and Tumor Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how inherited germline mutations predispose individuals to cancer and shape tumor progression and therapeutic response.

topics.label: Lecture Wrap-up and Supplementary Reading
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the presentation with final remarks and recommends reading material for the next session.
